allowed: actor-conditioned C2 intermediate policy evaluation on CAL
minimum-cardinality probing under frozen nominal and raw same-sample critical constraints
comparison to heuristic baseline and uncertainty-only policies
claim_boundary.paper_wording: C2 uses the endpoint-calibrated same-sample motion posterior's identifiable raw beam-criticality joint masses; the separately calibrated scalar Pcrit is reported but is not redistributed across beams.

historical_v1_absolute_joint_variant.reason_not_primary: The later controlled v1.1 amendment explicitly froze the C2 constraints as unchanged with the conditional 0.99*Pcrit form; v1.1.1 preserved them.

optimization.fallback: all beams selected on any input validation or solver failure
lexicographic_tiebreak: minimize raw critical missed sample count
optimization.primary_objective: minimize selected beam count K=sum_b z_b

primary_constraints.critical_integer_equivalent: for critical_count C>0: sum missed critical_beam_sample_counts <= floor(C/100)
primary_constraints.critical_probability_form: if Pcrit_raw>0: sum_b u_b_raw z_b >= 0.99 * Pcrit_raw
primary_constraints.nominal_integer_equivalent_M4096: sum selected beam_sample_counts >= 3892; equivalently sum missed beam_sample_counts <= 204
primary_constraints.zero_raw_criticality: if Pcrit_raw==0 the critical constraint is vacuous; nominal constraint remains active

Pcrit_cal.role: actor-level calibrated risk provenance/descriptive reporting only

primary_solver_inputs.p_b: Block9.5B raw same-sample beam probability mass
primary_solver_inputs.u_b_raw: Block9.5B raw same-sample critical-beam joint mass

scientific_role.claim: Actor-conditioned minimum-cardinality beam probing subject to nominal and raw same-sample near-term critical-future reliability constraints.
scientific_role.name: criticality_constrained_minimum_cardinality_beam_policy

why_scalar_calibration_not_redistributed.statement: The frozen scalar isotonic map identifies calibrated total actor-level critical-event probability but does not identify a calibrated beamwise joint distribution. Therefore Block9.7 does not define u_b_cal and does not multiply p_b by Pcrit_cal.
